heading: This Afternoon
text: Partly cloudy. Chance of showers or a thunderstorm. Highs from the mid 70s to lower 80s. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Variable clouds early, then clearing. Chance of early showers and storms north, mainly northeast, and slight chance to the south. Patchy valley fog late. Lows in the mid to upper 50s south and in the Champlain Valley, low to mid 50s elsewhere north. Northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 15 mph in the Champlain Valley, all diminishing late.

heading: Friday
text: Patchy valley fog early; otherwise mostly sunny or becoming so. Highs from the mid 70s to around 80 in the south, and in the broad valleys north, low to mid 70s elsewhere north. Northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph.
